_about: Hand-authored races, merged into the generated pack by tools/extract/build_documents.py (apply_manual_content). Put entries under "entries", keyed by name, with the item's system fields. A new name is added, tagged sourcebook "Custom" unless you give one. A name his data already builds is ignored unless the entry says "_override": true, in which case only the fields you give are laid over his. Keys starting with _ are notes and never read. Full guide: docs/ADDING-CONTENT.md. Rebuild with: python tools/extract/build_documents.py --write

_example._note: An example of the shape. Copy entries from here into "entries" to use them.

Fairy(Dark Wingless)._why: Wood Lore removed from the Dark Fairy's racial skills at the developer's instruction, 2026-09-21. His raceSkillDetailValues gives the WINGLESS form eleven skills, two of which -- Climb and Wood Lore +10% -- the winged form does not get; this drops Wood Lore from that list. Climb is left, because only Wood Lore was asked for. The winged form never had it and is untouched. Retargeted from "Fairy(Dark)" to "Fairy(Dark Wingless)" on 2026-09-21, when the faeries were split into winged and wingless races -- this was always an override of the wingless form and his own name for the race no longer names one. Remove this entry to go back to what his sheet says.
Fairy(Dark Wingless).racialSkillNote: Animal Shape: may also take the form of a D'Wisp (Darkened Wisp)
Fairy(Dark Wingless)._whyNote: Skill note added at the developer's instruction, 2026-09-22: a Dark Fairy's Animal Shape may take the form of a D'Wisp. Aspects of the Wild p.4 (Dark Fairy): 'The Animal Shape skill can also allow the Dark Fairy to assume the form of a DWisp (Darkened Wisp).' His sheet carries no note for the race, and -- worth knowing -- no Animal Shape in its racial skill list either, though the plain Fairy has it at +20%; that is logged as a question in docs/UPSTREAM-ISSUES.md, not changed here. Remove the racialSkillNote to go back to his sheet.
